policy_store.description: Path to the active SELinux policy store (typically provided by the SELinux policy package).

local_store.description: Directory where local semanage changes (e.g., user mappings, port ranges) are persisted.

use_dbm.description: Whether to use Berkeley DB (DBM) for faster access to policy store metadata.

max_cache_size.description: Maximum size (in bytes) for in-memory caches. Set to 0 for unlimited size.

fragment_dirs.description: Ordered list of directories containing optional semanage configuration fragments.

items.description: Absolute path to a directory with semanage configuration fragments.

boolean_defaults.description: List of SELinux booleans to pre-configure (e.g., enable/disable features) on policy reload.
